## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_advisory_lock.py
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] check_pass_lock returns False when no lock file on tickets branch
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_advisory_lock.py::test_check_pass_lock_absent
- [ ] check_pass_lock returns True when .reconciler-pass-lock present on tickets
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_advisory_lock.py::test_check_pass_lock_present
- [ ] Missing-tickets-branch failure semantics: check_pass_lock raises ReconcileLockError (fail-CLOSED) — bricks the orchestrator with a clear error rather than silently disabling concurrency
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_advisory_lock.py::test_missing_tickets_branch_fails_closed
- [ ] acquire/release roundtrip via _concurrency.rebase_retry (matches existing tickets-branch write pattern at _concurrency.py:72)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_advisory_lock.py::test_acquire_release_uses_rebase_retry
- [ ] check_phase_gate blocks Mode.BOOTSTRAP_THROTTLE when gate file present, allows Mode.BOOTSTRAP_STRICT
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_advisory_lock.py::test_phase_gate_blocks_advancement

## Implementation Notes

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_advisory_lock.py:

```python
class ReconcileLockError(RuntimeError):
    pass

def check_pass_lock(repo_root: Path) -> bool:
    # git -C repo_root show tickets:.reconciler-pass-lock
    # success → True (locked); exit-128 with 'unknown revision tickets' → raise ReconcileLockError (fail-closed)
    # exit-128 with 'exists on disk but not in tickets' → False (file absent on tickets branch)

def acquire_pass_lock(pass_id: str, repo_root: Path) -> None:
    # Use _concurrency.rebase_retry (plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_concurrency.py:72) to commit
    # .reconciler-pass-lock containing pass_id + timestamp_ns to tickets branch.
    # Pattern alignment per plan-review F3: do NOT invent a new write path.

def release_pass_lock(repo_root: Path) -> None:
    # Idempotent. Uses rebase_retry to commit the file deletion.

def check_phase_gate(target_mode: Mode, repo_root: Path) -> bool:
    # Returns True if .reconciler-phase-gate exists on tickets AND target_mode rank > gated_mode rank
    # Presence + rank-based: bootstrap-strict → bootstrap-throttle blocked when gate present;
    # operator removes file to advance.
```

## Failure-mode discipline (plan-review F3 + F7)
- Missing tickets branch: fail-CLOSED with ReconcileLockError. Rationale: silent fail-open would disable dd-3 concurrency protection.
- Tickets-branch writes: MUST use _concurrency.rebase_retry — the existing serialization-safe pattern. Naive 'git commit && git push' races with concurrent passes.
- Audit-log noise: 2 commits per pass (acquire + release) is acceptable; these commits are operator-visible signals of pass start/stop. Document in T5.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
